# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Role:** Scout / Courier

## Appearance

Pidgeon is a lean, agile young man built for swift movement and stealth. He typically wears lightweight, practical garments suited for traveling light through rough terrain.

## Personality

Observant and cautious, Pidgeon keeps a close eye on his surroundings to stay out of danger. He is loyal to his companions and takes pride in his ability to gather intelligence and deliver messages reliably.

## Traits

- Observant
- Cautious
- Swift-footed

## Abilities

- Scouting and reconnaissance
- Evasion and stealth

## Goals

- Safely gather information and assist his allies without getting caught

## History

Pidgeon serves as a trusted scout and messenger, navigating risky paths to gather intelligence. Throughout the events of the first two volumes, he aids his allies by monitoring enemy movements and delivering crucial reports.
